message.essentialcraft5.holopad.game_mod.en: Only a player in survival or adventure mode can activate the holopad
message.essentialcraft5.holopad.game_mod.zh: 只有生存或冒险模式的玩家能启动全息投影台

message.essentialcraft5.holopad.peaceful.en: Nothing answers the signal on Peaceful difficulty
message.essentialcraft5.holopad.peaceful.zh: 和平难度下，信号没有回应

message.essentialcraft5.holopad.dimensio.en: The holopad only works in Hoanna
message.essentialcraft5.holopad.dimensio.zh: 全息投影台只能在海纳尔启动

message.essentialcraft5.holopad.no_sky.en: The holopad needs open sky above it
message.essentialcraft5.holopad.no_sky.zh: 全息投影台头顶要露天

message.essentialcraft5.holopad.blocked.en: There is no room for the projection 5 blocks above the holopad
message.essentialcraft5.holopad.blocked.zh: 投影台上方 5 格的地方被挡住了，投影放不下

message.essentialcraft5.holopad.occupied.en: Another Holographic Projection or Inquisitorium Sentinel is within 64 blocks
message.essentialcraft5.holopad.occupied.zh: 64 格内已经有一个全息投影或审判庭哨兵了

message.essentialcraft5.holopad.denied.en: You may not use this holopad here
message.essentialcraft5.holopad.denied.zh: 你没有权限在这里启动全息投影台

advancements.essentialcraft5.hologram_bi.en: Defeat the Holographic Projection without wearing any armor
advancements.essentialcraft5.hologram_bi.zh: 不穿任何盔甲击败全息投影
